Review the current changes like a senior engineer.

Flag: (1) security issues, (2) performance bottlenecks, (3) missing error handling, (4) violations of `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

Return a numbered list. Each item: Severity (High/Med/Low) — Issue — Why it matters — Minimal suggested diff.
Do not rewrite whole files.
